    • getNewRecordModels

      public final <T extends com.velox.sapio.commons.exemplar.recordmodel.record.RecordModel> List<T> getNewRecordModels(List<T> recordModelsList)
      Given a list of record models, will return only the record models that are new.
      This method uses dataRecordManager.isNew so the record models are expected to be stored already so that they have a corresponding datarecord. Returns empty list if the passed list is null. Ignores if any one of the recordmodel in the passed collection is null.
      Parameters:
      recordModelsList -
      Returns:
      List of new record models.

      public com.velox.api.datatype.TemporaryDataType getDefinitonToAddRecord(String datatypeName, List<String> fieldsToExclude, List<String> fieldsToInclude) throws Throwable
      By default, this method is used to return the field definitions for a data type containing only the non-system, editable and visible fields.
      Parameters:
      datatypeName -
      fieldsToExclude - List of field names to be excluded from display. Could be null
      fieldsToInclude - List of system/non-editable/invisible fields that should be displayed and editable. Could be null.
      Returns:
      DataFieldDefinitions with relevant fields that could be used for form/table entry dialog

      Throwable
